Upon receipt and acceptance of the goods/services and receipt of complete invoices through both, i.e. TREDS platform and the required physical documents, NFL shall process the invoices exc lusively through the TReDS platform in accordance with the applicable statutory provisions and gui delines. The supplier may avail financing through the TReDS platform at its own discretion. All charges rela ting to invoice discounting/financing shall be borne solely by the supplier. NFL shall not be liable fo r any financing charges, interest or other costs arising out of such discounting. The above provisions shall be governed by the applicable provisions of the MSMED Act, 2006, the Ministry of MSME Notification(s), and amendments issued from time to time. E. IV) Issuing bank shall mention NFL beneficiary code as “NFLNATIONAL04022015 ” in field 7037 of IFN 760 COV / IFN 767 COV. H.
